"""Fixture (g): one not-equivalent site isolated while other rewrites stay."""

from agent_workflows import artifact_meta


def test_first_plan_rewrites() -> None:
    text = (
        "# IPD: First Valid Plan\n\n"
        "- Id: pl7001\n"
        "- Status: approved\n"
        "- Set: demo\n"
        "- Order: 1\n"
    )
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="ipd")
    assert st.id6 == "pl7001"
    assert st.status == "approved"


def test_layout_sensitive_spec_not_equivalent() -> None:
    text = (
        "# Spec: Layout Sensitive\n"
        "- Id: sp7002\n"
        "- Status: draft\n"
    )
    lines = text.splitlines()
    assert len(lines) == 3
    assert lines[1].startswith("- Id")


def test_third_release_rewrites() -> None:
    text = (
        "# Release: 2.0.0\n\n"
        "- Id: rl7003\n"
        "- Status: planned\n"
        "- Version: 2.0.0\n"
        "- Summary: Kept release rewrite\n"
    )
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="release")
    assert st.id6 == "rl7003"
    assert st.status == "planned"
